title: How Noise-Cancelling Headphones Erase Sound 🎧 #shorts
description:
Noise-cancelling headphones fight noise by adding more sound. A mic listens to the noise, a chip plays the same wave flipped upside down, and peaks meet valleys until they cancel. Here's why it crushes engine hum but not voices, and the 1950s cockpit idea it came from.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
